Vote - AcceptText - Accept with following changes, including emendations to mark the differences between Delattre's original AfP article and Hasitzka's SBKopt. edition. An educational note for the text-enterer: where supralinear strokes or superscript letters indicate abbreviation, omit those signs in the edition; also note that the Greek portion of a Greek regularisation does not mark abbreviations, even though the Coptic part does. See below for examples! lin1: † ==> *stauros* ; ⲡⲁⲣ̄ ==> (ⲡⲁⲣ(ⲁ)) ; ⲡϥⲥϩⲁⲓ ==> <:ⲡϥ̣ⲥ̣ϩ̣ⲁ̣ⲓ̣=A. Delattre, AfP 54 (2008) 80|ed|ⲡϥⲥϩⲁⲓ:> ; ⲡⲣⲱⲙⲉ̣ ==> <:ⲡⲣⲱⲙⲉ=A.
